rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for a building, especially a residential or commercial one.

example.english: There are lots of shops in that building.
example.jyutping: go2 dung6 lau4 jau5 hou2 do1 gaan1 pou3 tau4

rows.note: Use this for a large or multi-storey building such as an apartment or office block.

example.jyutping: ni1 zo6 daai6 haa6 jau5 saam1 sap6 cang4 lau4

rows.note: Use this formal generic term when referring to a physical structure as a building, especially in written or technical contexts.

example.english: That building has been added to the list of declared monuments.
example.traditional: 該建築物已列入法定古蹟名單。
example.jyutping: goi1 gin3 zuk1 mat6 ji5 lit6 jap6 faat3 ding6 gu2 zik1 ming4 daan1

rows.note: Use this for the construction work or process of building a physical structure, not for the finished building.

example.english: This building construction project is expected to be completed by the end of the year.
example.traditional: 呢項建築工程預計年底完成。
example.jyutping: ni1 hong6 gin3 zuk1 gung1 cing4 jyu6 gai3 nin4 dai2 jyun4 sing4
